test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-II Official Paper-I (Held On: 18 Jan, 2025)
subject: general
question:
Match the file locating features in column A with their corresponding functionalities in column B.

 
 

 
 **Column A**
 
 **Column B**
 
 

 1.
 Search Bar
 a)
 Displays files and folders recently accessed
 
 

 2.
 Quick Access
 b)
 Allows grouping and sorting of files by attributes
 
 

 3.
 Wildcards
 c)
 Refines searches for files with partial names
 
 

 4.
 File Sorting
 d)
 Locates files and folders by typing keywords
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Search Bar:** Locates files and folders by typing keywords.
 
• **Quick Access:** Displays files and folders recently accessed.
 
• **Wildcards:** Refines searches for files with partial names.
 
• **File Sorting:** Allows grouping and sorting of files by attributes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Search Bar:**

 
 
• A tool used in various operating systems and software to quickly locate files and folders by entering relevant keywords.
 
• Improves productivity by reducing the time taken to find specific items.
 
 
 
• **Quick Access:**
 
 
• A feature in file management systems that shows recently accessed files and folders for quick retrieval.
 
• Helps users easily access frequently used files and folders without navigating through multiple directories.
 
 
 
• **Wildcards:**
 
 
• Special symbols like '*' and '?' used in search queries to represent unknown characters or strings.
 
• Enhances search capabilities by allowing searches for files with partially known names.
 
 
 
• **File Sorting:**
 
 
• A functionality in file systems that enables the arrangement of files based on various attributes such as name, date, size, and type.
 
• Facilitates better organization and easier retrieval of files.
